Chapter 1137: Chapter 7 Xuanhuang Universe (Subscription Requested)

The desolate void between the Ripple Cloud Void Domain and the Anbo Void Domain.

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint rarely stopped the slaughter, carefully observing the corner of the universe’s aura that had been revealed.

The hatred between her and the Shadow Demon Great Saint was indeed relentless and unending.

But this glimpse of the universe discovered now involved a peerless Great Saint.

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint could not help but take it seriously.

Although a peerless Great Saint is also at the peak of the Chaos Realm, the same as the Chaos Great Saint Realm, their combat power is significantly higher than the latter.

Moreover, every peerless Great Saint has much exploration and understanding in impacting the Thirteenth Dimension.

The peerless Great Saints search through the Chaos Void, pursuing traces of life at the Thirteenth Dimension, and have gained some insights and rewards.

These rewards are undoubtedly crucial for the Chaos Great Saints and may even increase the likelihood of impacting the Thirteenth Dimension.

Both Chaos Great Saints and peerless Great Saints can impact the Thirteenth Dimension, but the latter has made far more preparations, and their chances of success are naturally higher.

“Unexpectedly, shortly after being promoted to the Great Saint, I discovered a universe opened by a peerless Great Saint—a great opportunity, a tremendous opportunity!”

The Shadow Demon Great Saint’s heart surged with excitement; at the stage of Chaos Realm’s perfection, few things could attract him.

Resources? Chaos Great Saints do not lack resources, as they have reached the pinnacle in all aspects, and having more resources does not enhance them much.

The peerless Great Saint’s combat power surpasses the Chaos Great Saint’s not because of resources, but due to the chaos path they have evolved on their own.

Weapons? Actually, Chaos Great Saints also do not lack weapons; unless it’s weapons of the Thirteenth Dimension level, their interest is generally not significant.

For any Chaos Great Saint, there is only one thing that attracts them most.

That is the Thirteenth Dimension.

Impacting the Thirteenth Dimension is the goal of every Chaos Great Saint.

Many Chaos Great Saints have lived through long Cosmic Eras, and their relatives and friends have mostly died, leaving only the obsession to impact the Thirteenth Dimension.

“The interior of this universe already shows trends of breaking apart, otherwise, it couldn’t have been blasted out a corner; even without my attack, hundreds or thousands of Cosmic Eras later, this corner would still be exposed.”

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint also continuously observed.

She could clearly perceive that this universe developed postnatally was unbelievably ancient, originating from tens of thousands of Cosmic Eras ago.

“After so many Cosmic Eras have passed, many time spaces inside this universe are near collapse and remain unrepaired, suggesting its creator likely hasn’t returned.”

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint drew many conclusions.

Not returning to a universe you developed for such a long time? Letting its interior time and space collapse can only mean a few possibilities.

One, this peerless Great Saint is dead.

Two, this peerless Great Saint is impacting the Thirteenth Dimension and has not succeeded yet, being trapped in a time loop.

Three, this peerless Great Saint reincarnated.

…

Amongst the three possibilities, the Nine Phoenix Great Saint believes the second is closest to the truth.

But no matter which one, it signifies that this peerless Great Saint may have difficulty appearing in the world again.

Even considering the third reincarnation possibility, having not recovered all memories and returned to the peak for such a long time, the hope of returning to this universe is slim.

For Chaos Realm’s strong reincarnation means, the hope of recovery is greatest in the first life; failing to recover in the first life means significantly fewer awakened memories in the second, and even less in the third, fourth, and so on.

Even for a peerless Great Saint, if they haven’t returned to the peak in the third life, they typically can’t return anymore, losing memories with each reincarnation.

…

“Nine Phoenix, you should also know the importance of this universe; the grievances between us can be set aside temporarily to join hands in exploring this universe.”

The Shadow Demon Great Saint glanced at the Nine Phoenix Great Saint, speaking.

Normally, before a peerless Great Saint impacts the Thirteenth Dimension, they would leave everything behind— their weapons and treasures, insights and experiences, exploration of the Thirteenth Dimension, and so on.

Indeed, impacting the Thirteenth Dimension basically has only two possibilities.

Success or being trapped in a time loop.

If successful, ascending to become a time life of the Thirteenth Dimension, the weapons, treasures, insights, and explorations left behind are of no importance; even if others know, they just know.

If they fail, trapped in an eternal time loop, the weapons, treasures, insights, and explorations left behind have no impact, and if it helps create a Thirteenth Dimension time life, it might even rescue them from the time loop.

Indeed.

The time loop of a perfected Twelfth Dimension can be interfered with by a Thirteenth Dimension life.

Of course, even for a Thirteenth Dimension time life, forcibly breaking a certain time loop would come at a great cost, but it’s always a glimmer of hope.

And for such a perfected Twelfth Dimension life that is rescued by external interference, it would equate to losing the opportunity to impact the Thirteenth Dimension.

“Join hands to explore?”

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint looked at the Shadow Demon Great Saint.

“Indeed, even if you kill me, your closest family and clan cannot be resurrected, but as long as you step into the Thirteenth Dimension, you can reverse the timeline and resurrect your deceased closest family and clan.”

The Shadow Demon Great Saint spoke.

The revival of deceased beings in the Twelfth Dimension is based on the river of time, using the life imprint as an anchor point for resurrection.

So, when one ascends to the Twelfth Dimension, shedding the constraints of time life, the life imprint leaps out of the river of time, losing the ability to be revived.

However, for Thirteenth Dimension time life?

Thirteenth Dimension time life can see many future timelines and past timelines; the resurrection means they can accomplish is to resurrect against the timeline.
